narr: In the afternoon hours on July 16th, isolated thunderstorms developed due to very moisture rich Gulf air in place combined with ample afternoon destabilization. Weak wind flow aloft allowed for slow movement with these storms leading to isolated areas of flash flooding to develop.
ev: Report of high water on the Paris Avenue underpass near Gentilly Boulevard. High water reported across roads in the area.
lsr: HIGH WATER ON PARIS AVE UNDERPASS NEAR GENTILLY BLVD.
